reason: A prompt-only DSH plugin that guides agents to route image-recognition tasks to a configured mimo-v2.5 workflow subagent, with read_image as fallback.

summaries.zh: 通过注入系统提示词，引导 DSH 智能体将图像识别任务路由到配置的 mimo-v2.5 子智能体，并在不可用时回退到 read_image。
summaries.en: A prompt-only DSH plugin that guides agents to route image-recognition tasks to a configured mimo-v2.5 subagent and fall back to read_image when unavailable.

capabilities: Injects system-prompt guidance for image-recognition task routing
Can guide an agent to dispatch a workflow subagent when the workflow tool and configured model are available
Falls back to the host read_image capability when subagent dispatch is unavailable
